anomaly_signals.detail: 594 errors out of 1000 spans — 59.4% error rate. Likely acting as an error amplifier for all downstream failures. Front-door is critically impacted.
281 errors out of 577 spans (48.7% error rate) and 291 genAI tool failures system-wide. Tool execution is severely degraded, impacting agent workflows.
257 errors out of 1000 spans (25.7% error rate). Auth failures are propagating broadly, blocking downstream service access.
245 errors out of 542 spans (45.2% error rate). Nearly half of all agent operations are failing, likely due to tool-executor and LLM failures.
164 errors out of 877 spans (18.7% error rate) combined with a system-wide p99 latency of 29,473ms. LLM backend is a primary latency driver.
30 genAI token truncation events detected. Prompts or responses are being cut short, degrading response quality and potentially causing downstream parsing errors.
138 errors out of 1000 spans (13.8% error rate). Database-layer auth failures are compounding auth-service instability.
105 errors out of 390 spans (26.9% error rate). Over a quarter of payment operations are failing — direct revenue/transaction risk.
75 errors out of 390 spans (19.2% error rate). DB-layer payment failures correlating with payments-service degradation, suggesting db_degradation scenario is active.
100 errors out of 542 spans (18.5% error rate). Memory retrieval failures will degrade agent context quality and consistency.
66 errors out of 271 spans (24.4% error rate). Nearly 1 in 4 workflow orchestration steps is failing, likely cascading from agent and tool failures.

recommended_action: IMMEDIATE: Triage tool-executor and api-gateway as top priorities — they show the highest absolute and relative error counts. Investigate tool_failure root cause (likely misconfigured or unreachable external tool endpoints) and apply circuit breakers. Simultaneously, check llm-gemini for timeout/throttling config causing the ~29.5s p99 latency; enforce request timeouts and enable fallback LLM routing. Validate postgres-auth and postgres-payments connection pool health to resolve cascading DB degradation. Review token truncation events for prompt size limits on llm-gemini.
summary: A severe multi-scenario fault injection ("all") is active across the full service mesh, with a 26.2% system-wide error rate and a critical p99 latency of ~29.5 seconds. The blast radius spans every service layer — from api-gateway (59.4% errors) and tool-executor (48.7% errors / 291 tool failures) through auth, payments, LLM, and database tiers — indicating simultaneous db_degradation, llm_latency_spike, tool_failure, and auth/payment service degradation scenarios are all live.
